blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Real-world driving requires context-aware decision-making. Existing end-to-end driving benchmarks primarily assess trajectory quality through safety, compliance, comfort, and driving progress, leaving context-dependent decision-making insufficiently characterized. To fill this gap, we present PlanContext, a benchmark for evaluating in-context driving decision-making. PlanContext constructs paired evaluations by varying high-level driving intentions while keeping the observed scene fixed, enabling a natural and controllable assessment of context-dependent decision-making. We further define six representative driving contexts and jointly evaluate contextual decision correctness, road compliance, and dynamic safety with class-balanced metrics. Experiments on 9,561 scene-condition instances from NAVSIM and 23 public end-to-end driving models show that high conventional driving-quality scores do not consistently correspond to strong route-level in-context driving decision-making. Further analysis shows that model behavior varies with decision timing, road structure, and traffic interaction depending on the decision required by the current context. Our results highlight in-context driving decision-making as an important complementary dimension for evaluating end-to-end driving systems.
blocks.zh: 现实世界的驱动需要了解背景的决策。 现有的端到端驱动基准主要通过安全、合规、舒适和驱动进度来评估轨迹质量,使取决于具体情况的决策没有得到充分描述。 为了填补这一空白,我们提出PlanContext,作为评估内在驱动决策的基准。 PlanContext通过不同的高级驱动意图构建配对评价,同时使所观察到的场景保持固定,从而能够自然和可控地评估取决于具体情况的决策。 我们进一步界定了六个具有代表性的驾驶环境,并联合评估了相关决策的正确性、道路合规性以及动态安全性,并采用了分类平衡的衡量标准。 对NAVSIM的9561个场景条件例和23个公用端对端驾驶模型的实验显示,高常规驾驶质量分数与强大的路由级内接力驾驶决策不一致. 进一步的分析显示,模型行为因决策时间,道路结构,以及交通互动而异,这取决于当前环境需要的决定. 我们的成果突出表明,推动决策是评价端到端驱动系统的一个重要的补充方面。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Autonomous driving has attracted growing attention from both academia and industry due to its potential to improve road safety and transportation efficiency ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Janai et al., 2020 ) . The community has developed a wide range of end-to-end driving models that integrate sensory observations, ego states, and high-level driving intentions to directly predict future trajectories or driving actions ( Chitta et al., 2022 ; Hu et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2026a ) . As model families and technical paradigms continue to diversify, reliable evaluation and fair comparison of driving performance have become increasingly important for measuring progress in the field.
blocks.zh: 自主驾驶因其在提高道路安全和运输效率方面的潜力而吸引了学术界和工业界越来越多的关注(Chen等人,2024年;Janai等人,2020年)。 社区开发了广泛的端对端驱动模式,将感知观测,自我状态,高层次驱动意图结合起来,直接预测未来的轨迹或驱动动作(Chitta等人,2022年;Hu等人,2023年;Zhou等人,2026a年). 由于模范家庭和技术模式继续多样化,对驾驶业绩的可靠评价和公平比较对衡量该领域的进展越来越重要。

blocks.en: However, comprehensively characterizing the decision-making capabilities of end-to-end driving models remains challenging. Existing benchmarks primarily assess trajectory quality through metrics such as collision avoidance, road compliance, comfort, and driving progress ( Caesar et al., 2020 ; Jia et al., 2024 ; Cao et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . While these metrics are effective for measuring whether a model produces safe and reasonable trajectories, a high-quality trajectory alone does not establish that the model has correctly interpreted the current driving context and made an appropriate decision. As shown in Fig. 1 , models with high PDMS under the original navigation command can still respond inappropriately when the command changes. In Fig. 1 (a), the vehicle has already started a left-turn maneuver, and a newly issued right-turn command should not trigger an immediate reversal that drives the vehicle toward a pedestrian. Similarly, in Fig. 1 (b), when a turning instruction is given before the corresponding maneuver becomes locally feasible, the policy should continue to follow the current road rather than turn immediately and leave the drivable area. These cases highlight that driving decisions should be made in accordance with the current driving context. A reliable autonomous driving policy should jointly consider contextual information such as the current vehicle state, road geometry, and high-level navigation intention to make an appropriate decision. Yet existing benchmarks offer limited insight into such in-context decision-making capability, allowing context-inappropriate decision failures to remain hidden behind strong trajectory-level performance.
blocks.zh: 然而,全面描述端到端驱动模式的决策能力仍然具有挑战性。 现有基准主要通过避免碰撞、遵守道路、舒适度和驾驶进度等衡量标准评估轨迹质量(凯撒等人,2020年;贾等人,2024年;曹等人,2025年;张等人,2026年)。 虽然这些衡量标准对于衡量一个模型是否产生安全合理的轨迹是有效的,但仅靠高质量的轨迹并不能确定该模型是否正确解释了目前的驱动环境并作出了适当的决定. 如图1所示,在原导航指令下具有高PDMS的模型在命令改变时仍然可以不适当地响应. 在图1(a)中,车辆已经开始左转操作,新发布的右转命令不应引发立即逆转,将车辆推向行人。 同样,在图1(b)中,当在相应行动在当地可行之前发出转弯指示时,政策应继续沿着目前的道路走,而不是立即转弯,离开可驾驶地区。 这些案件突出表明,应根据目前的驱动环境作出驱动决定。 可靠的自主驾驶政策应共同考虑背景信息,如目前的车辆状况、道路几何和高层导航意图,以便作出适当决定。 然而,现有的基准对这种内在决策能力提供了有限的洞察力,使得不适当的决策失败仍然隐藏在强劲的轨迹水平业绩之后。

blocks.en: To address this gap, we introduce PlanContext , a benchmark for systematically evaluating in-context driving decision-making in end-to-end autonomous driving. PlanContext keeps sensor observations and vehicle history fixed while applying controlled changes to high-level navigation intentions, enabling paired comparison of model decisions under the same environmental context. Based on road topology, target reachability, decision timing, and ongoing vehicle motion, we construct representative driving contexts and define context-specific requirements for whether an intention should be executed, deferred, rejected, or preserved. PlanContext jointly evaluates contextual decision correctness, road compliance, and dynamic safety, and further analyzes model behavior under different contextual factors. In this way, PlanContext extends end-to-end driving evaluation beyond trajectory quality toward a systematic assessment of intention–context–decision consistency.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了PlanContext,这是系统评价在端到端自主驾驶中驱动决策的内在文本的基准。 PlanContext保持传感器观测和飞行器历史固定不变,同时对高水平导航意图进行有控制的改变,从而能够在同一环境背景下对示范决定进行对等比较。 根据道路地形、目标可达性、决策时间和进行中的车辆运动,我们构建了具有代表性的驾驶环境,并确定了关于是否应当执行、推迟、拒绝或保留意图的具体条件。 PlanContext联合评价了背景决定的正确性,道路合规性和动态安全性,并进一步分析了不同背景因素下的模型行为. 这样,PlanContext将端到端的驱动评价扩展到轨迹质量之外,以系统评估意图-context-决策的一致性。

blocks.en: Based on PlanContext, we construct 9,561 strictly filtered scene–condition instances from NAVSIM ( Dauner et al., 2024 ) and evaluate 23 publicly available end-to-end driving models spanning three paradigms: vision/state-to-action, vision-language-action, and world-model-based action. Model rankings under conventional driving-quality evaluation differ substantially from those under route-level in-context evaluation. Across all 23 models, contextual success reaches only 22.46% at best when the driving context requires executing an immediately actionable alternative route. Moreover, no consistent performance trend emerges across model paradigms: VA, VLA, and WA models all exhibit substantial within-paradigm variation in in-context decision-making performance. Our key contributions are threefold:
blocks.zh: 基于PlanContext,我们从NAVSIM(Dauner等人,2024年)构建了9,561个严格过滤的场景-条件实例,并评价了23个可公开使用的端对端驱动模式,这些模式跨越三个范式:愿景/状态-行动、愿景-语言-行动以及基于世界模式的行动。 常规驾驶质量评价下的模型排名与路线一级内文评价的排名差别很大。 在所有23种模式中,当驱动环境需要执行可立即采取行动的替代路线时,环境成功率最多只能达到22.46%。 此外,在模式范式中,没有出现连贯一致的业绩趋势:VA、VLA和WA模式在格式内决策业绩方面都显示出很大的差异。 我们的主要贡献有三:

blocks.en: • We introduce PlanContext, a benchmark for in-context driving decision-making with 9,561 curated scene–condition instances. It enables systematic evaluation of whether end-to-end models make appropriate decisions by jointly considering driving context and high-level intentions. • PlanContext provides evaluation criteria and metrics for in-context driving decision-making across six scenario categories. The evaluation jointly assesses contextual decision correctness, road compliance, and dynamic safety, with separate metrics for route-level and lane-level performance. • Our evaluation of 23 end-to-end driving models shows that conventional driving-quality metrics do not fully capture in-context decision-making capability. Further analyses reveal category-dependent performance patterns across decision timing, road structure, and traffic interactions.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: End-to-end autonomous driving directly maps sensory observations and vehicle states to future trajectories or actions. Recent approaches span perception–planning architectures, direct trajectory regression, generative planners, vision–language–action models, and world-model-based driving systems ( Jiang et al., 2023 ; Chitta et al., 2022 ; Liao et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . Beyond sensory inputs, modern models increasingly incorporate navigation goals and structured scene information into decision-making. Recent work further shows that decision-relevant traffic elements, including traffic lights, road signs, and lane topology, consistently affect planning performance across diverse end-to-end paradigms ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . These developments motivate evaluation beyond aggregate trajectory quality toward how models use contextual information when making driving decisions.
blocks.zh: 端对端自主驱动直接将感官观测和车辆状态映射到未来的轨迹或动作. 近期的方法跨越认知-规划架构、直接轨迹回归、基因规划、愿景-语言-行动模型和世界模型驱动系统(Jiang等人,2023年;Chitta等人,2022年;Liao等人,2025年;Zhou等人,2026年b年;Wang等人,2026年a年)。 除了感官投入外,现代模型越来越多地将导航目标和结构化场景信息纳入决策. 最近的工作进一步表明,与决策有关的交通要素,包括交通灯、道路标志和车道地形,始终影响不同端到端范式的规划业绩(Zhang等人,2026年)。 这些事态发展促使评价超越总体轨迹质量,转向模型在作出驱动决策时如何使用背景信息。

blocks.en: End-to-end driving evaluation has evolved from open-loop trajectory similarity toward more comprehensive measurements of driving quality and robustness. NAVSIM ( Dauner et al., 2024 ) introduces data-driven non-reactive simulation and evaluates predicted trajectories through collision, road compliance, comfort, time-to-collision, and driving progress. Closed-loop benchmarks such as Bench2Drive ( Jia et al., 2024 ) further evaluate interactive driving performance, while NAVSIMv2 ( Cao et al., 2025 ) augments logged data with synthetic observations to assess recovery from ego deviations. Fail2Drive ( Gerstenecker et al., 2026 ) further examines closed-loop generalization by pairing distribution-shifted routes with in-distribution counterparts under changes in appearance, layout, and agent behavior. These benchmarks substantially improve the evaluation of trajectory quality, safety, and robustness. PlanContext provides a complementary evaluation perspective by examining whether driving decisions remain appropriate under different combinations of high-level intentions and environmental contexts, thereby revealing aspects of decision-making that are not captured by conventional driving-quality metrics.
blocks.zh: 端到端驾驶评价已经从开阔轨迹的相似性演变为对驾驶质量和稳健性进行更全面的测量。 NAVSIM(Dauner等人,2024年)引入了数据驱动的非反应模拟,并通过碰撞,道路合规,舒适,时间到碰撞,以及驱动进度来评价预测的轨迹. Beach2Drive(Jia等人,2024年)等闭路基准进一步评价互动驾驶性能,而NAVSIMv2(Cao等人,2025年)则用合成观测数据增加记录数据,以评估自我偏差的恢复情况。 Fail2Drive(Gerstenecker等人,2026年)在外观,布局和代理行为的变化下,通过配对分配的变换路线与分配中的对等路线,进一步考察了闭路通化. 这些基准大大改善了对轨迹质量、安全和稳健性的评价。 PlanContext提供了一个补充性评价视角,它审查在高级别意图和环境背景的不同组合下,驱动决定是否仍然适当,从而揭示了传统驱动质量衡量标准所未包含的决策的各个方面。

blocks.en: High-level navigation commands help resolve behavioral ambiguity in end-to-end driving ( Codevilla et al., 2018 ; Chitta et al., 2022 ) . NavControl ( Wu et al., 2025 ) constructs feasible alternative commands in NAVSIM and evaluates navigation compliance alongside driving quality. ICR-Drive ( Hamid et al., 2026 ) assesses robustness to goal-preserving and goal-conflicting language perturbations on matched CARLA routes, using the original navigation objective as the evaluation reference. Beyond driving policies, What-If World ( Cai et al., 2026 ) evaluates whether video world models produce the expected physical outcomes under paired prompts differing in a single physical variable. PlanContext targets context-dependent decision correctness through paired intention changes with observations and vehicle history fixed. Its criteria account for road topology, target reachability, decision timing, and ongoing motion, assessing both the semantic validity of individual predictions and whether paired predictions exhibit context-appropriate behavioral adjustment or preservation.
blocks.zh: 高级导航指令有助于解决端对端驾驶中的行为模糊性(Codevilla等人,2018年;Chitta等人,2022年). NavControl (Wu等人,2025年)在NAVSIM中构建了可行的替代指令,并评价导航合规性与驾驶质量. ICR-Drive(Hamid等人,2026年)评估了在匹配的CARLA路线上保持目标与目标冲突语言扰动的稳健性,以原始导航目标作为评价参考. 除了驱动政策,What-If World(Cai等人,2026年)评价视频世界模型是否在对齐的提示下产生预期的物理结果,在一个单一的物理变量中有所不同. PlanContext通过对意图的修改进行配对,固定观察和车辆历史,从而针对取决于具体情况的决定正确性。 其标准包括道路地形、目标可达性、决定时间和持续运动,既评估个人预测的语义有效性,又评估配对预测是否显示适合上下文的行为调整或保存。

blocks.en: 3 PlanContext: Evaluating In-Context Driving Decision-Making
blocks.zh: 3 计划背景:评估内容内驱动决策

blocks.en: PlanContext evaluates in-context driving decision-making through paired navigation interventions and context-aware assessment. We first introduce the intervention protocol and the construction of representative driving contexts in Sections 3.1 and 3.2 . Section 3.3 then defines the contextual decision evaluation criteria, followed by the class-balanced performance metrics in Section 3.4 .
blocks.zh: PlanContext通过对齐的导航干预和对背景的认识评估来评价内在的驱动决策. 我们首先在第3.1和3.2节中介绍干预协议和建立有代表性的驾驶环境。 然后,第3.3节界定了相关决策评价标准,然后是第3.4节中的类别平衡业绩计量。

blocks.en: The valid behavior sets introduced in Section 3.1 are determined by the driving context of each scene–condition instance. We characterize this context using road topology, target reachability, decision timing, and the ongoing motion state of the ego vehicle. Together, these factors determine how a high-level driving intention can be appropriately realized in the current scene.

blocks.en:
PlanContext organizes the resulting instances into four contextual requirements: follow , wait , reject , and preserve . Follow applies when the alternative target is currently reachable and should be executed within the evaluation horizon. Wait describes cases where the target becomes feasible in the near future while the current state still favors maintaining the existing route. Reject covers locally unreachable targets or cases where the vehicle has already passed the appropriate decision point. Preserve applies when an ongoing maneuver should remain temporally consistent after the intention changes.
We instantiate these requirements with six complementary scenario categories, summarized in Table 1 and illustrated in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh:
PlanContext将由此产生的实例分为四个背景要求:遵循、等待、拒绝和保存。 当替代目标目前可以达到并且应该在评价范围内执行时,则适用后续。 等待描述了在近期内目标变得可行而目前状态仍然倾向于维持现有路线的情况. 拒绝涵盖当地无法达到的目标或车辆已经通过适当决定点的情况。 保留适用于在意图改变之后正在进行的行动应保持时间上的一致性。
我们用表1和图2概述的6个补充情况类别对这些要求进行即时分析。

blocks.en: The route-level categories A, B1, B2, and C capture different stages of navigation feasibility and route commitment. A represents an immediately actionable route change, while B1 contains targets that become feasible beyond the current decision window. B2 captures locally unsupported intentions, and C describes scenes in which the ego vehicle has already committed to the original route. The lane-level categories complement these route-level contexts: L evaluates feasible adjacent-lane transitions, while LC evaluates the continuity of an ongoing lateral maneuver.

blocks.en: To further assess benchmark validity, three reviewers with backgrounds in autonomous driving independently inspected a randomly sampled subset of 500 scene–condition instances and 11,500 model-instance evaluations from all 23 evaluated models after the evaluation rules were finalized. The reviewers were blinded to the automated evaluation results during independent assessment. Following discussion, approximately 0.7% of the inspected model-instance evaluations were judged inconsistent with the automated evaluation outcomes. Detailed findings are provided in Appendix D.9 .

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: PlanContext is constructed from the NAVSIM navtest split. After scenario mining and context-aware filtering, the benchmark contains 9,561 scene–condition instances from 5,911 unique physical scenes. The six contextual categories include 334 A, 251 B1, 5,285 B2, 580 C, 2,716 L, and 395 LC instances. For each retained instance, the sensor observations and vehicle history are fixed, while the evaluated model is queried under both the original navigation intention and the corresponding alternative intention.
blocks.zh: PlanContext由NAVSIM导航测试分解构建. 经过情景挖掘和背景感知过滤后,基准包含9,561个场景-条件实例,来自5,911个独特的物理场景。 六个背景类别包括334 A、251 B1、5 285 B2、580 C、2 716 L和395 LC案例。 对于每个保留的例子,传感器观测和车辆历史都是固定的,而评估过的模型则根据原始导航意图和相应的替代意图进行询问。

blocks.en: We evaluate 23 publicly available end-to-end driving models covering three representative paradigms. Vision/state-to-action (VA) models directly predict driving trajectories from sensory or state inputs, vision-language-action (VLA) models incorporate vision-language representations into planning, and world-model-based action (WA) models explicitly predict or encode future scene dynamics. All models are evaluated using publicly released or official assets, with navigation conditions explicitly involved in inference. Their outputs are standardized as eight future ego poses over a 4-second horizon.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了23种可公开使用的端到端驱动模式,涵盖三个有代表性的模式。 远景/状态到行动(VA)模型直接预测从感官或状态输入的驱动轨迹,视觉语言-行动(VLA)模型将视觉语言表述纳入规划,基于世界模型的行动(WA)模型明确预测或编码未来的场景动态. 所有模型都使用公开发布或官方资产进行评估,导航条件明确涉及推论。 其产出已标准化,因为今后有8个自我在4秒内形成。

blocks.en: For each model, we report its conventional driving performance on the full NAVSIM navtest split using PDMS. To enable a scene-matched comparison with PlanContext, we additionally compute matched PDMS (mPDMS) under the original navigation condition on the same 5,911 physical scenes selected by PlanContext. Each physical scene contributes once to mPDMS, even when it is associated with multiple alternative navigation conditions. PlanContext then performs paired inference under the original and alternative navigation intentions on the 9,561 scene–condition instances. We report NAS, CPS, and NCS for route-level in-context driving decision-making, and LAS and MCS for lane-level evaluation. We additionally report contextual success rates for all six categories.

Pairwise model comparisons are computed on matched bootstrap samples, with Benjamini–Hochberg correction applied across all 253 pairwise comparisons.

blocks.en: Table 2 presents the overall results of the 23 evaluated models. Figures 3(a) – 3(e) compare conventional driving quality with route-level and lane-level in-context performance. mPDMS evaluates driving quality under the original navigation condition, while NCS evaluates in-context driving decision-making through paired navigation interventions. The Spearman rank correlation between mPDMS and NCS is − 0.542 -0.542 , indicating substantial differences in model rankings across the two evaluations. Confidence intervals, pairwise comparisons, and sensitivity analyses of model rankings are provided in Appendices D.3 and D.7 .

blocks.en:
Figure 3 further reveals two interesting patterns:
(1) High mPDMS does not consistently correspond to high NAS. All models with mPDMS above 85 achieve NAS of at most 1.80, while OneVL achieves the highest NAS of 22.46 with an mPDMS of 80.79.
(2) Different model architecture paradigms do not exhibit a consistent performance trend on PlanContext. VA, VLA, and WA models all show substantial performance variation within each paradigm, suggesting that the architectural paradigm alone does not consistently explain in-context driving decision-making performance.

blocks.en: We further investigate how in-context driving performance varies with environmental context under different decision requirements. All analyses use the contextual success indicator q i q_{i} defined in Section 3.3 and aggregate predictions from all 23 evaluated models. blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present PlanContext, a benchmark for evaluating in-context driving decision-making through paired navigation interventions under fixed observations and vehicle history. Across 9,561 scene–condition instances and 23 end-to-end driving models, we find that strong conventional driving quality does not consistently correspond to strong in-context decision-making. Our analyses further show that model performance varies across different decision requirements and environmental contexts. These results indicate that in-context driving decision-making captures a capability dimension not fully reflected by conventional driving-quality metrics. By evaluating intention–context–decision consistency across route-level and lane-level scenarios, PlanContext provides a structured benchmark for assessing how end-to-end driving models respond to high-level intentions under different driving contexts.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍的是PlanContext,这是在固定观测和车辆历史中通过对联导航干预来评价内在驱动决策的基准。 在9,561起场景条件性案例和23起端对端驾驶模式中,我们发现强大的常规驾驶质量并不一致于强大的内在决策。 我们的分析还表明,不同决策要求和环境背景的模型性能各不相同。 这些结果表明,驱动决策的内在内容抓住了传统驱动质量衡量标准没有充分反映的能力层面。 PlanContext通过评价意向-context-决定在路由一级和车道一级方案的一致性,为评估端到端驱动模式在不同驱动情况下如何响应高层意图提供了一个结构化的基准.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement

blocks.en: PlanContext evaluates in-context driving decision-making using existing driving scenes from NAVSIM ( Dauner et al., 2024 ) and publicly released or official model assets. All experiments are conducted offline, without interventions on real vehicles or road users. The human validation procedure involves expert inspection of existing scenes and model predictions, as described in Appendix D.9 . Responsible reuse of the benchmark requires adherence to the source data licenses and protection of privacy in driving-scene imagery.

blocks.en: Appendix A Scenario Construction Details

blocks.en: This section provides the detailed scenario mining, filtering, and category assignment criteria used to construct PlanContext. The construction process first removes scenes with insufficient geometric or motion evidence. It then identifies reliable route branches and adjacent lane structures from the local map. Each retained scene–condition instance is assigned to one of the six contextual categories according to a fixed priority order. This procedure is designed to ensure that each category corresponds to a sufficiently clear contextual requirement.

blocks.en: A scene is first assigned to category C when strict post-commitment evidence is detected. blocks.en: Category B2 contains alternative left or right intentions that do not correspond to a locally reachable target in the requested direction. blocks.zh: B2类包含左侧或右侧的替代意图,与请求方向的可达到的本地目标不符. 场景不得包含所请求方向的可靠近路分支,也不得在同一路障内设置几何可行的相邻目标车道.

blocks.en: We conservatively exclude candidates for which the local map still provides evidence of a potentially reachable target. In particular, a candidate is excluded from B2 whenever at least one branch associated with the alternative direction is detected and its decision point lies within the four-second logged travel distance, N replacement > 0 N_{\mathrm{replacement}}>0 (24) and d decision ≤ D GT 4 ​ s . d_{\mathrm{decision}}\leq D_{\mathrm{GT}}^{4s}. blocks.en: Candidates are also excluded when an adjacent lane exists but fails the required geometric continuity checks. These exclusions reduce ambiguity in the B2 set by removing cases with residual evidence of a potentially reachable target.
blocks.zh: 在相邻航道存在但未能按规定进行几何连续检查时,候选人也排除在外. 这些排除规定消除了具有可能达到目标的剩余证据的案件,从而减少了B2规定的模糊性。

Appendix B Category-Specific Evaluation Rules
blocks.zh: 附录B 特定评价规则

blocks.en: This section provides the detailed trajectory comparison and category-specific behavioral evaluation rules used by PlanContext. Given the original prediction T i N T_{i}^{N} and the prediction under the alternative navigation intention T i F T_{i}^{F} , we first represent both trajectories with respect to the reference geometry required by each evaluation component. We then determine their topological outcomes, identify persistent behavioral changes induced by the navigation intervention, and evaluate whether these changes satisfy the contextual requirement of each category.
blocks.zh: 本节提供PlanContext所使用的详细轨迹比较和特定类别的行为评价规则. 考虑到最初的预测T i N T_{i}^{N}和在替代导航意图T i F T_{i}^{F}下的预测,我们首先代表了每个评价组成部分所需的参考几何学的两个轨迹。 然后,我们确定它们的地形结果,确定导航干预引起的持续行为变化,并评估这些变化是否满足了每个类别的背景要求。

blocks.en: B.1 Notation and Reference Geometries
blocks.zh: B.1 标记和参考地名

blocks.en: Each prediction contains eight future ego states sampled at 0.5 s intervals over a four-second horizon. Predicted poses are interpreted at the rear axle center and transformed into the global SE(2) coordinate frame.
blocks.zh: 每个预测都包含8个未来自我状态,在4秒的视野内每隔0.5秒取样. 预测的姿势在后轴中心进行解释,并转化为全球SE(2)坐标架.

blocks.en: We use two reference geometries for different evaluation purposes. The original-route reference is used to characterize the path-level difference between the original and alternative predictions. The logged GT trajectory provides a local reference for the suppression tests of B1, B2, and C and for the continuity evaluation of LC. The GT reference represents the natural road evolution observed in the scene and is not treated as a trajectory target to be imitated.
blocks.zh: 我们使用两个参考几何来进行不同的评价。 最初的路由参考用来描述原始预测和替代预测的路径级差异. 记录的GT轨迹为B1、B2和C的压制试验和LC的连续性评价提供了当地参考。 GT参考代表了现场所观察到的自然道路演化,不作为模仿的轨迹目标.

blocks.en: B.2 Evaluation Structure
blocks.zh: B.2 评价结构

blocks.en: The category-specific criteria are constructed from a shared set of trajectory-level primitives, including route-topology assignment, road-relative trajectory change, GT-relative residual change, full-vehicle road compliance, and dynamic safety. Each contextual category selects the evidence required by its behavioral objective.
blocks.zh: 具体类别标准是根据一套共同的轨迹一级原始物构建的,包括路线地形分配、道路相对轨迹变化、GT相对残留变化、全车辆遵守公路规则和动态安全。 每个背景类别选择其行为目标所要求的证据.

blocks.en: Categories A and L evaluate whether a feasible alternative intention is executed. Categories B1, B2, and C evaluate whether the alternative navigation condition induces an unnecessary persistent deviation from the locally appropriate behavior. Category LC evaluates the continuity of an ongoing lateral maneuver.
blocks.zh: 类别 A和L评价是否执行了可行的备选意图。 B1、B2和C类评价替代导航条件是否导致不必要地持续偏离适合当地的行为。 LC 类评价正在进行的横向行动的连续性。

blocks.en: This factorized design keeps the underlying geometric measurements shared across categories while allowing the decision criterion to reflect the corresponding contextual requirement. Continuous trajectory evidence is evaluated using fixed decision thresholds and boundary regions. Clear evidence contributes to the category-specific decision outcome, while boundary-level evidence is retained for uncertainty-aware evaluation. All category definitions and thresholds are fixed and shared across models.
blocks.zh: 这种因子化的设计使基本的几何测量数据在各类别之间保持共享,同时允许决策标准反映相应的背景要求。 利用固定的决定阈值和边界区域评价连续的轨迹证据。 明确的证据有助于特定类别的决定结果,而边界一级的证据则保留用于对不确定性的认知评价。 所有类别的定义和阈值都是固定的,并在各个模型之间共享。

blocks.en: This section describes the road-compliance and dynamic-safety evaluation used by PlanContext, followed by the aggregation of instance-level results into the final benchmark metrics. These components are evaluated separately from the contextual decision correctness defined in Sec. B .
blocks.zh: 本节介绍PlanContext所使用的道路合规性和动态安全性评价,然后将实例层面的结果汇总到最后基准衡量标准中。 这些组成部分与Sec.B.所界定的背景决定正确性分开评估。

blocks.en: C.1 Full-Vehicle Road Compliance
blocks.zh: C.1 全车辆道路合规

blocks.en: Road compliance is evaluated using the complete ego-vehicle footprint at every predicted future state. Each predicted pose is interpreted at the rear axle center. We use the dimensions of the Pacifica vehicle model, with a length of 5.176 m and a width of 2.297 m. The rear axle is located 1.461 m behind the geometric center of the vehicle footprint.

blocks.zh: 对于车道一级内衬驱动决策,莱恩适应积分(LAS)和马内弗连续积分(MCS)分别是L和LC的背景成功率. 这些分数单独报告,不列入NCS.

blocks.en: For comparison with conventional driving quality, matched PDMS is computed on the same 5,911 physical scenes used by PlanContext under the original navigation condition. Each physical scene contributes once to matched PDMS even when it is associated with multiple alternative navigation conditions.
blocks.zh: 与传统的驾驶质量相比,PlanContext在原始导航条件下使用的5 911个物理场景上计算出匹配的PDMS。 每个物理场景即使与多个替代导航条件相关联,也会一次贡献匹配PDMS.

blocks.en: This section provides additional details on the benchmark composition, model evaluation protocol, statistical analysis, contextual factor definitions, and robustness analyses used in PlanContext. The definitions of scenario construction, contextual correctness, road compliance, and metric aggregation are provided in Secs. A , B , and C .
blocks.zh: 本节提供了更多详情,说明PlanContext中使用的基准构成、模型评价协议、统计分析、背景因素定义和稳健性分析。 假设情景构建、背景正确性、道路合规性和计量汇总的定义见Secs。 A,B,和C。 (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: D.1 Benchmark Composition
blocks.zh: D.1 基准构成

blocks.en: PlanContext is constructed from the NAVSIM navtest split. The final benchmark contains 9,561 scene–condition instances derived from 5,911 unique physical scenes. A physical scene may contribute multiple scene–condition instances when multiple alternative navigation intentions satisfy the construction criteria.
blocks.zh: PlanContext由NAVSIM导航测试分解构建. 最终基准包含9,561个场景-条件实例,来自5,911个独特的物理场景. 当多个替代导航意图符合建造标准时,物理场景可能会造成多个场景条件。

blocks.en: The six contextual categories contain 334 A, 251 B1, 5,285 B2, 580 C, 2,716 L, and 395 LC instances. Table 8 summarizes the benchmark composition.
blocks.zh: 六个背景类别包括334 A、251 B1、5 285 B2、580 C、2 716 L和395 LC案例。 表8汇总了基准构成。

blocks.en: Table 8: Composition of the PlanContext benchmark.
blocks.zh: 表8:计划内容基准的构成。

blocks.en: The benchmark is category imbalanced because the six contextual conditions occur at different frequencies in NAVSIM. We therefore use the class-balanced aggregation defined in Sec. C.4 instead of a direct micro-average over all instances.
blocks.zh: 该基准存在类别不平衡,因为六个背景条件发生在NAVSIM的不同频率. 因此,我们使用第C.4节所界定的分类平衡汇总,而不是在所有情况下直接的微观平均数。

blocks.en: D.2 Model Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: D.2 示范评价议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate 23 publicly available end-to-end driving models covering three representative paradigms. Vision and state to action models directly predict future trajectories from sensory observations or state inputs. Vision language action models incorporate vision language representations into driving policies. World model based action models explicitly predict or encode future scene dynamics before producing driving actions.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了23种可公开使用的端到端驱动模式,涵盖三个有代表性的模式。 远景和状态到行动模型直接通过感官观测或状态输入来预测未来的轨迹. 远景语言行动模式将远景语言表述纳入驱动政策。 基于世界模型的行动模型在产生驱动动作之前明确预测或编码未来场景动态.

blocks.en: All models are evaluated using publicly released or official assets. Navigation conditions are explicitly involved during inference. Model outputs are standardized to eight future ego poses sampled over a four-second prediction horizon.
blocks.zh: 所有模型都使用公开发布或官方资产进行评估。 在推断过程中明确涉及导航条件. 模型产出被标准化为未来8个自负,在四秒钟的预测范围内进行了抽样。

blocks.en: For each scene–condition instance, the model is evaluated twice. The first inference uses the original navigation intention c i N c_{i}^{N} . The second inference uses the alternative navigation intention c i F c_{i}^{F} . Sensor observations and vehicle history remain unchanged between the two evaluations. This paired protocol isolates the behavioral response to the navigation intervention while preserving the observed scene.
blocks.zh: 对于每个场景条件的例子,该模型都会受到两次评价. 第一种推论使用原始导航意图c i N c_{i}^{N}. 第二种推论使用替代导航意图c i F c_{i}^{F}. 传感器观察和车辆历史在两次评价之间保持不变。 这个配对协议在保存被观测到的场景的同时,隔离了对导航干预的行为反应.

blocks.en: For conventional driving evaluation, we report PDMS on the full NAVSIM navtest split. We additionally compute matched PDMS, denoted as mPDMS, on the same 5,911 physical scenes used by PlanContext. mPDMS is evaluated under the original navigation condition. Each physical scene contributes once to mPDMS even when it produces multiple scene–condition instances in PlanContext.
blocks.zh: 对于传统的驱动评价,我们报告PDMS 在NAVSIM导航测试的完整分裂。 在PlanContext使用的5,911个物理场景上,我们额外计算匹配的PDMS,表示为mPDMS. mPDMS在原始导航条件下进行评估. 每个物理场景都为mPDMS贡献过一次,即使它在PlanContext中产生了多个场景-条件实例.

blocks.en: The PlanContext evaluation covers all 9,561 scene–condition instances across the six categories. For each model, we report NAS, CPS, and NCS for route-level evaluation, LAS and MCS for lane-level evaluation, and the six category-wise contextual success rates.
blocks.zh: PlanContext评价涵盖所有9 561个场景 -- -- 6个类别的情况。 对于每个模型,我们报告NAS、CPS和NCS用于路由级评价,LAS和MCS用于车道级评价,以及六类背景成功率。

blocks.en: D.3 Statistical Analysis
blocks.zh: D.3 统计分析

blocks.en: We estimate uncertainty using scene-level bootstrap resampling. The resampling unit is the unique physical scene token instead of an individual scene–condition instance. This design preserves the dependence among multiple navigation conditions constructed from the same physical scene.

blocks.en: For each bootstrap replicate, 5,911 scene tokens are sampled with replacement. All scene–condition instances associated with a sampled scene are retained together. Predictions from all evaluated models associated with the same sampled scene are also retained together. This produces matched bootstrap samples across models and preserves the paired evaluation structure.

blocks.zh: D.4 实施和可复制细节

blocks.en: All reported PlanContext results use the same fixed scenario construction and evaluation rules described in Secs. A , B , and C . The category definitions, geometric thresholds, path-change criteria, GT-relative suppression rules, LC continuity rules, road-compliance constraints, and metric aggregation are shared across all evaluated models.
blocks.zh: 所有报告的PlanContext结果都采用了Secs中所述的相同的固定情景构建和评价规则。 A,B,和C。 (中文(简体) ). 类别定义、几何阈值、路径变化标准、GT-相对抑制规则、LC连续性规则、道路合规限制和计量汇总在所有评价模型中都有。

blocks.en: The evaluation operates on model trajectories after conversion to a common representation of eight future ego poses over four seconds. Predicted poses are interpreted at the rear axle center before geometric evaluation. Road-relative projection, topology assignment, paired trajectory comparison, road-compliance evaluation, and NAVSIM safety evaluation are applied using the same procedure for every model.
blocks.zh: 在转换为八个未来自我的共同代表后,评价在模式轨迹上运作,占4秒多。 在几何评价前,先在后轴中心解释预期的姿势。 道路相对投影、地形分布、对准轨迹比较、道路合规性评价以及NAVSIM安全性评价在每种模型中采用相同的程序。

blocks.en: Cases with ambiguous scene geometry are removed during benchmark construction according to Sec. A . Geometry-related states produced during model evaluation are handled according to the rules in Sec. B . For category LC, predictions assigned the uncertain continuity state are excluded from the valid denominator when computing the category success rate.

blocks.en: The benchmark construction and evaluation pipeline uses fixed category assignments and fixed evaluation thresholds for all reported results. Model comparisons are performed on the same scene–condition definitions under the same evaluation protocol.

blocks.en: The decomposition reveals distinct failure profiles across contextual requirements. Category A is constrained by both alternative-condition correctness and road compliance. Its Alt.-Condition Correctness is 44.94%, while RoadOK is only 19.49%, resulting in a contextual success rate of 10.01%. Category L shows a different pattern. RoadOK and Dynamic Safety reach 97.57% and 94.16%, respectively, whereas Alt.-Condition Correctness is only 3.51%. This suggests that failures in L primarily arise from the inability to execute the feasible alternative lane intention.
blocks.zh: 分解揭示了不同背景要求的不同故障情况。 类别 A受到其他条件正确性和遵守道路两方面的限制。 其Alt.-Contition的校正率为44.94%,而RoadOK的校正率为19.49%,导致背景成功率为10.01%. 类别 L显示了不同的模式. RoadOK和动态安全分别达到97.57%和94.16%,而Alt.-Contition的正确性仅为3.51%。 这表明,L的失败主要是由于无法执行可行的替代航道意图。

blocks.en: Category C retains relatively high alternative-condition correctness at 88.12%, while RoadOK and Dynamic Safety reduce the final contextual success to 34.98%. B2 and LC achieve the highest contextual success among the six categories at 73.28% and 85.64%, respectively. For B1, the high Alt.-Condition Correctness does not imply that every detected behavioral response is appropriate because longitudinal adjustment and waiting can remain valid under its contextual requirement.
blocks.zh: 类别 C保留相对较高的替代条件正确性,为88.12%,而RoadOK和动态安全公司将最终成功率降至34.98%。 B2和LC在六个类别中分别取得了73.28%和85.64%的最高成功。 对于B1,高Alt.-Contition的正确性并不意味着每个检测到的行为反应都是适当的,因为纵向调整和等待在其上下文要求下仍然有效.

blocks.en: D.9 Human Expert Validation
blocks.zh: D.9 专家鉴定

blocks.en: After the scenario construction and evaluation rules were finalized, three reviewers with backgrounds in autonomous driving independently inspected the same randomly sampled subset of 500 scene–condition instances and 11,500 model-instance evaluations from all 23 evaluated models. The reviewers were blinded to the automated evaluation results during independent assessment. They subsequently discussed their judgments to reach a final consensus.
blocks.zh: 在情景构建和评价规则确定之后,三名具有自主驾驶背景的评审员独立地检查了500个场景条件的随机抽样子集和来自所有23个评估模型的11 500个模型模拟评价。 在独立评估期间,审查人员对自动评价结果视而不见。 他们随后讨论了他们的判断,以达成最后共识。

blocks.en: For scenario construction, the reviewers identified 3 of the 500 scene–condition instances whose assigned contextual categories were inconsistent with their consensus judgments. For model-instance evaluation, the final consensus differed from the automated evaluation outcomes for approximately 0.7% of the 11,500 inspected model-instance evaluations.
blocks.zh: 关于情景构建,审查人员在500个场景条件实例中确定了3个,其指定的背景类别与其共识判断不一致。 就模拟评价而言,在11 500项已检查的模拟评价中,最终共识与自动化评价结果相左,约占0.7%。

blocks.en: The audit also identified ambiguity in the original NAVSIM navigation labels. Further examination of their construction provides context for this observation. NAVSIM assigns directional commands by thresholding the lateral displacement of a point 20 m ahead along the route centerline, with left/right thresholds of ± 2 \pm 2 m ( Dauner et al., 2024 ) . Its left/right commands encompass turns, lane changes, and sharp curves, leaving the maneuver type unspecified. In the inspected cases, some lane changes were associated with left/right labels, while others were not.
blocks.zh: 审计还发现,最初的NAVSIM导航标签有模糊之处. 对这些建筑的进一步审查为这一意见提供了背景。 NAVSIM通过沿路线中心线向前20米处的横向移位来分配方向命令,左/右阈值为±2\pm 2米(Dauner等人,2024年). 它的左/右命令包括转弯、车道变化和锐利的曲线,使操作类型未具体说明。 在所检查的案件中,有些车道改变与左/右标签有关,而另一些则没有。

blocks.en: This ambiguity may partly contribute to the poor performance observed in category L, since the same left/right commands can correspond to different maneuver types during training.
blocks.zh: 这种模棱两可的情况可能部分地造成L类中观察到的不良表现,因为同一左/右命令在训练期间可对应不同的操作类型。
